final: WITH g AS (SELECT mj.college AS college, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member mem JOIN major mj ON mj.major_id = mem.link_to_major GROUP BY mj.college), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.college AS college, g.cnt AS cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM p) SELECT p.college, p.cnt, p.ratio, p.cnt - a.av AS diff_from_avg FROM p JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE p.cnt > a.av
